---
name: test-case-generation
description: Create test scenarios and manual test cases for frontend.html, with traceability between scenarios and cases, and generate an Excel file for the results.
---

Read `frontend.html` document and generate test scenarios and manual test cases. Generate a proper traceability across test scenarios and test cases.

Test scenarios should have below columns in it:
- Scenario id
- Brief description
- Linked test cases

Test cases should be in tabular format with at least below columns in it:
- Test case name
- Precondition
- Objective
- Test steps
- Expected Result

Generate an excel file for the same.
